select count(1) from (SELECT a.id,max(a.plan_name) plan_name,max(a.cycle) cycle,max(a.frequency) frequency, max(a.type_name) type_name,max(a.team_id) team_id,max(a.team_name) team_name, max(a.begin_date) begin_date,max(a.end_date) end_date,max(a.`status`) `status`, max(a.remark) remark,max(a.dormancy_begin) dormancy_begin,max(a.type_id) type_id, max(a.dormancy_end) dormancy_end,GROUP_CONCAT(b.factory_id) factory_id, GROUP_CONCAT(c.field_name) AS factory_name,max(a.update_time) update_time, max(a.update_emp) update_emp,max(a.update_emp_no) update_emp_no,max(a.plan_type) plan_type FROM safety_patrol_plan A LEFT JOIN safety_patrol_link_plan_factory B ON A.ID = B.PLAN_ID LEFT JOIN safety_field_manage c ON b.factory_id = c.id WHERE 1 = 1
group by a.id) tmp where 1 = 1

select a.id, a.cycle_role_id, a.cycle_role_name, b.factory_id, a.begin_date, a.team_id, a.team_name, a.dormancy_begin, a.dormancy_end, a.cycle, a.begin_date, a.end_date, a.plan_name, a.cycle, a.type_id, a.type_name FROM safety_patrol_plan a LEFT JOIN safety_patrol_link_plan_factory b ON a.ID = b.PLAN_ID where a.plan_type = 3 and a.status = 0 and #{beginDate} >= a.begin_date and a.end_date >= #{beginDate}
